title: Cable Connect
subtitle: Live chargers connected to Cable over OCPP 1.6
searchPlaceholder: Search by id, name, station, serial, vendor

subscription.title: Cable Connect subscription
subscription.hint: Record or renew the station's Cable Connect payment here. While the subscription is off, the apps hide this station's charger data — the chargers themselves keep working.

detail.title: Charger details
detail.neverBooted: Never connected yet — waiting for the first BootNotification

register.title: Add charger
register.stationHint: Search by name, city or ID — the Cable station this charger belongs to
register.chargePointIdHint: Leave empty to generate CBL-{station}-{nn}. Use the unit's existing id (e.g. RH4) to keep it. Max 20 characters (OCPP limit).
register.requirePasswordHint: Off by default: units on OCPP Security Profile 0 (e.g. RH4) cannot send a password and would be refused with 401. Turn on only for units that support HTTP Basic.

credentials.title: Charger credentials
credentials.warning: Shown once. Copy them now — the password cannot be retrieved later, only replaced.
credentials.noPassword: No password — the charger connects by id only.
credentials.portHint: If the charger has a separate port field, set it to {{port}}. A unit coming from another platform usually still has that platform's port (RH4: 4435).

confirm.rotateBody: The current password stops working at the charger's next reconnect. You will see the new one once.
confirm.clearBody: The charger will be admitted by its id alone (Security Profile 0).
confirm.disableBody: Its connection is closed within a minute and new connections are refused. History is kept.
confirm.deleteBody: The id becomes free for re-registration. Refused while a session is open.
confirm.removeTagBody: It will no longer be accepted at this station.

tags.title: Allowed cards
tags.subtitle: Only these cards / passwords can start a charge through Cable
tags.idTagHint: As printed or scanned, up to 20 characters
tags.label: Label
tags.empty: No cards yet — every Authorize is answered Invalid until one is added

station.title: Cable Connect
station.noChargers: No chargers registered for this station

commands.title: Remote control
commands.offlineHint: Charger is offline — commands need a live connection
commands.unlockHint: Releases the cable lock; any running session is stopped first

confirm.resetSoftBody: The charger restarts its software after any running session ends, then reconnects by itself. Expect it Offline for about a minute.
confirm.resetHardBody: The charger reboots immediately. A running session is cut. It reconnects by itself in one to two minutes.
confirm.unlockBody: A running session on that plug is stopped first. Use it when a driver cannot remove the cable.
confirm.unitOffTitle: Take the whole unit out of service?
confirm.offBody: It shows Unavailable in the apps and refuses new sessions. A running session finishes first (Scheduled). It stays out of service until you put it back.
confirm.unitOnTitle: Put the whole unit back in service?
confirm.stopBody: The charger ends the session now and reports the final meter reading. Use it for a stuck session or a car that must be released; the driver is not asked.
confirm.startBody: For the customer whose car is connected to this plug (no card needed). The charger starts within a few seconds and the session is recorded as started by you. It is priced from the time-of-use tariff like any other session.

commands.stopHint: Ends session #{{session}} on the charger (reason Remote). The driver can unplug afterwards.
commands.startHint: Starts a session on this plug for the customer whose car is connected (no card needed). The charger confirms with its StartTransaction.
commands.plugInFirstHint: Start session appears once a car is connected to this plug (the charger reports Preparing). Starting into an empty plug would only wait 60 s and cancel.

config.title: Charger settings
config.hint: Read the unit's own configuration keys. Nothing is cached — this asks the charger right now.
config.rebootRequired: saved — takes effect after a reset

localList.title: Cards on the unit
localList.hint: Pushes the station's allowed cards into the charger so it keeps authorizing them when Cable is unreachable. Runs by itself after every card change.
localList.synced: Card list pushed — {{count}} cards on the unit

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.noDriver: card not linked to a user

title.Refused: The charger tried to connect and was refused

body.Waiting: Nothing has reached the server from this id yet. Type the URL, port and Charge Point ID into the unit, save, and reboot it. This card updates by itself.
body.Connected: The unit opened the socket but has not sent BootNotification yet. It usually follows within seconds; if it does not, reboot the unit.
body.Refused: Check the id typed into the unit (it is case-sensitive), the password setting, and that the charger is enabled here.

onboarding.bootedBody: Boot received: {{vendor}} {{model}}, firmware {{firmware}}. The live state above now reflects the unit.

visibility.title: Live data for drivers
visibility.hint: Drivers see free plugs, plug type, power — and faults — only when every gate below is open.
visibility.notDecided: turns on with the first subscription payment unless the owner decides
visibility.ownerSwitchHint: Belongs to the owner; use it here only on their request. Off = nothing is shown to drivers.
visibility.blockTitle: Hide this station's live data from drivers?
visibility.blockBody: Use for wrong data or a dispute. The owner sees the reason. The block never turns sharing on — only the owner can.
visibility.shareOnBody: All Cable app users will see this station's live plug status — free, charging or faulted — on the map and the station page. Turn it on only at the owner's request.
visibility.shareOnGates: Drivers see it only once the subscription is active and Cable has not blocked the station.
visibility.shareOffBody: Cable app users will no longer see this station's live plug status. The chargers keep working.

reliability.title: Reliability, last {{days}} days
reliability.recomputeHint: Recomputes every charger's 30-day score now (the job runs daily at 03:30 UTC)

alertThresholds.title: Alert thresholds
alertThresholds.hint: When the alert job warns about this station. Blank = the platform default. Checked every 5 minutes, so a change applies within 5 minutes.

summary.noSubscriptionHint: Stations with chargers but no active Cable Connect subscription
summary.title: Fleet summary

stations.title: Stations
stations.reliabilityHint: Average 30-day reliability of this station's chargers
stations.noAlerts: No open alerts at this station

liveConn.connectedHint: Live: changes appear the moment a charger reports them
liveConn.connectingHint: Connecting to live updates — refreshing every 15 s meanwhile
liveConn.pollingHint: Live updates are not available — refreshing every 15 s

session.title: Charging now
session.loadError: Live figures are not available right now

limit.title: Stop at
limit.hint: Cable stops the session by itself when it reaches this. Choose “No limit” to charge until the car or the operator stops it.

payments.title: Charging revenue
payments.subtitle: Value of Cable Connect charging sessions per station
payments.stationsError: Couldn't load the stations and chargers.
payments.partial: Couldn't load the sessions of: {{names}}. The figures leave them out.
payments.capped: The period is long for these stations, so only their latest 2,000 sessions are shown: {{names}}. The oldest sessions may be missing; pick a shorter period.
payments.emptyHint: Try a longer period or clear some filters.
payments.note: Values follow Cable's time-of-use tariff. How the driver paid isn't recorded by the system, so the page shows how each session started (card / driver app / staff) and its value in JOD. No loyalty or QR transactions are included.

filters.label: Filters
filters.badRange: Start date is after end date

summary.label: Period summary
summary.openHint: Running sessions are not added to the total until they end; the amount shown is their value so far.

chart.title: Daily value
chart.hint: In JOD per day. Hover or focus a bar for details.

daily.title: By day
daily.hint: Click a day to see its sessions, and a session for its details and price breakdown.

session.title: Session #{{id}}
session.detailError: The price breakdown isn't available for this session right now.
